comment: How admin password-reset requests are rate-limited — by IP, email, both, or not at all.
modal: Limits admin forgot-password requests by **By IP and Email**, **By IP**, **By Email**, or **None**, to throttle abuse of the password-reset flow.

comment: How storefront password-reset requests are rate-limited — by IP, email, both, or not at all.
modal: Limits storefront customer forgot-password requests by **By IP and Email**, **By IP**, **By Email**, or **None**, to throttle abuse. Can differ per store view.
